privileged_info_summary: The task inserts a synthetic test feature 'Nova Cartografia' at Brasília coordinates (-15.7801, -47.9292) with a fictional population of 45,000 (actual Brasília population is 2.8+ million) into GeoServer's ne:ne_populated_places layer backed by Natural Earth data. The feature attributes (adm0name='Brazil', featurecla='Populated place', pop_max=45000) follow real Natural Earth schema. GeoServer runs at http://localhost:8080/geoserver with admin/Admin123! credentials; PostGIS (kartoza/postgis:15-3.3) stores imported Natural Earth ne_110m_populated_places shapefile data. The task requires constructing a WFS-T Insert transaction XML and saving both the transaction and response XML files. All geographic coordinates, attribute names, GeoServer configuration, and data provenance are confirmed; the feature being inserted is synthetic/test data.
